newsitem.title: USA: Barnett sets option plan for all employees.
newsitem.headline: Barnett sets option plan for all employees.

text.p: -- Barnett Banks, Inc said Wednesday it awarded options to purchase 200 shares of the company's stock to all 22,000 of the company's full-time and part-time employees.

The exercise price of the 200 options granted each employee is based on the average of the high and low price of Barnett's common stock on Jan. 13, 1997. Employees will have the opportunity to exercise their option to purchase 200 shares of Barnett common stock at $41, once Barnett's stock price has reached $66 per share for five days during 10 consecutive trading days, or five years from the official grant date, whichever occurs first.
Barnett said the vesting schedule was selected to reward employees for long-term performance and provide enhanced employee ownership in the company.
Barnett shares closed down 3/4 at 41 Wednesday.
